title: This AI video tool costs 1/10th of traditional production
description:
Higgsfield just released an official MCP connector for Claude. Connect it once, describe the style you want, pick a reference, and Claude turns it into a full motion-graphics video, running top models like Kling and Veo under the hood. A freelance motion video runs $300 to $2,000. This runs on a few dollars of credits.

Get the full Higgsfield + Claude setup here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RKn7ayrLFsIteN1yu978uQWv-TCUXteL3YBchbXiZ5o/edit?usp=sharing
